shards.description: Number of shards (primaries) of the cluster.

image.description: Overrides the image of the nodes, as `repository:tag`. Defaults to `dependencies.valkey.image`.

workloadType.description: Workload of every node. Can not be changed after creation. `Deployment` does not support persistence.

config.description: Valkey configuration directives (valkey.conf), eg `maxmemory-policy: allkeys-lru`. Booleans are written as `yes` and `no`.

resources.description: Resources of the Valkey containers. Defaults to the `resources` of the chart.

persistence.description: Persistence of the nodes. Requires `workloadType: StatefulSet`, and can not be added or removed after creation.

exporter.description: Metrics exporter sidecar of every pod.

scheduling.description: Scheduling of the pods: `tolerations`, `nodeSelector`, `affinity`, `topologySpreadConstraints`, `priorityClassName`, `node` and `zone` (spreading and pinning). Passed to the `ValkeyCluster` as is.

podMetadata.description: Labels and annotations added to every pod. The operator rejects the keys it sets itself.

imagePullSecrets.description: Secrets used to pull the images. An item is a name, or an object with a `name`.

podSecurityContext.description: Overrides of the security context of the pods. Defaults to the `securityContext` of the chart (`runAsUser`, `runAsGroup`, `fsGroup`).

serviceAccountName.description: Name of an existing ServiceAccount for the pods.

terminationGracePeriodSeconds.description: Grace period of the pods in seconds. The operator calculates it when unset.

containers.description: Patches of the containers of the pods (strategic merge patch, by name: `server` and `metrics-exporter`), or additional sidecar containers.

networking.description: Networking of the cluster. TLS is not supported, as the credentials and the wait init container connect without it.

name.description: Name of the user. Can not start with `_`.

users.description: Additional users of the cluster, see the [valkey-operator docs](https://github.com/valkey-io/valkey-operator/blob/main/docs/valkeycluster.md#users). The `default` user always exists with the password of the credentials, an item named `default` overrides its settings.
